method: Historical event candidates. Source-linked claims are not substitutes for independent outcome measurements. No automatic scoring.

cases.event: President Trump directed a second U.S. withdrawal from the Paris Agreement; notice and effective date are separate milestones.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Measure implementation, financing, diplomatic leverage and climate policy effects after effective withdrawal.

cases.event: U.S. executive order initiated withdrawal from World Health Organization; completion, obligations and institutional consequences require separate verification.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Verify legal completion, funding, access and independently measured global-health diplomacy consequences.

cases.event: EU–Japan Strategic Partnership Agreement entered into force.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Measure subsequent implementation, trade/security cooperation and counterfactual effects.

cases.event: Solomon Islands government reported 25 corrections officers departed for training in China in June 2025; date recorded at month precision.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Confirm precise date, training completion, operational effects, and whether any bilateral influence changed.

cases.event: U.S. announced additional tariffs on imports from Canada, Mexico and China; orders, suspensions and effective application must be separated.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Measure actual tariffs applied, retaliation, bilateral trade, consumer costs and negotiated concessions.

cases.event: India and UK announced conclusion of free trade agreement negotiations; signing, ratification and entry into force require distinct milestones.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Verify legal status, implemented tariff changes and realized trade outcomes.

cases.event: Second U.S. Paris Agreement withdrawal became effective, distinct from 2025 notice.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Measure funding, participation and observed policy changes without inferring a net influence score.

limitations: Some actor lists identify comparison relevance rather than treaty parties.
Dates may be milestone or month placeholders; verify against primary source before publication.
No case is an independently measured net geopolitical gain or loss.
